payload.question: Does the council answer freedom of information requests on time?
payload.label: Freedom of information requests answered on time, Q1 2025/26
payload.council_caveat: The council notes this "represents an improvement relative to the previous two quarters". The council publishes these numbers as screenshots of a dashboard inside a PDF, so they cannot be read by machine. We read them off the images by eye, which is why this measure is flagged for human checking.
payload.evidence: Anyone can ask a council for information it holds, and the law gives it 20 working days to answer. Norwich aims to hit that deadline 95% of the time. In the first quarter of 2025/26 it managed 95.9%.

ai.reviewed_by: two independent AI review passes, reconciled against the source documents, 8 September 2026
